# AKS Chemicals

> AKS Chemicals is a manufacturer and supplier of textile chemicals based in Lahore, Pakistan, established in 1987. It supplies textile mills in Pakistan and abroad with chemistry for the whole wet process, from grey cloth to finished fabric, and offers confidential toll manufacturing.

## Product ranges

- Pretreatment: desizing, scouring, bleaching and mercerising. Getting the cloth clean, even and absorbent before any colour goes near it.
- Dyeing Auxiliaries: levelling, dispersing, sequestering and fixing agents, so the shade is right first time and holds across the batch.
- Finishes: softening, handle building, hydrophilic finishing and resin finishing.
- Denim Washing: desizing, enzyme wash, bleaching and neutralising for garment washing.
- Special Finishing: water repellents, oil repellents and flame retardants.

## Toll manufacturing

Confidential contract manufacturing: the customer brings the formulation, AKS provides the vessels, the controls and the people who run them.

## Beyond textiles

The same plant supplies chemistry to the tissue, wet wipe and cleaning industries.

## Standards

- ISO 9001 registration for the quality management system.
- A REACH compliance programme covering substances supplied into European supply chains.
